description: Login page, AppShell integration in App.jsx, Dashboard page, and POS page with all three POS components (ProductSearch, Cart, Receipt). Depends on FEAT-001 (needs CSS, stores, layout, mock data). Independent of FEAT-003 and FEAT-004.
steps: Read context.json and FEAT-001 findings before starting. Verify FEAT-001 is completed by checking that npm run build passes.

Write src/pages/Login.jsx mirroring GLSI's Login.js structure exactly. Centered white card (max-width:360px) on var(--bg) background. Top: plant emoji (🌿) large centered, then h1 'AGROVET POS' in var(--brand) uppercase 16px 800-weight, subtitle 'Veterinary & Agro Chemical Point of Sale' in muted 12px. Form: Email label (11px uppercase 700-weight #555) + input (search-input class), Password label + input type=password. Error block (brand border-left:3px solid var(--danger), light red bg, dark red text 12px). Submit button uses .btn class, full width, 'Sign In' text. On submit: if useMock, call authStore.login('demo@demo.com', 'demo') which sets demo admin user, then navigate('/dashboard'); else call authStore.login(email, password). If error display in error block.

Write src/App.jsx. Import useEffect from react, Routes/Route/Navigate from react-router-dom, useAuthStore from store/authStore, AppShell from components/layout/AppShell, ProtectedRoute from components/layout/ProtectedRoute, Login from pages/Login, and lazy-load all 10 other pages (Dashboard, Inventory, POS, Sales, Purchasing, Suppliers, Customers, Expenses, Reports, Settings) with React.lazy + Suspense. In App component: useEffect(() => authStore.initialize(), []). Routes tree: path='/' -> Navigate to='/dashboard'. path='/login' -> if user: Navigate to='/dashboard'; else: Login. All other paths wrapped in ProtectedRoute then AppShell: '/dashboard' -> Dashboard, '/inventory' -> Inventory, '/pos' -> POS (allowedRoles=['admin','manager','cashier']), '/sales' -> Sales, '/purchasing' -> Purchasing (allowedRoles=['admin','manager']), '/suppliers' -> Suppliers (allowedRoles=['admin','manager']), '/customers' -> Customers (allowedRoles=['admin','manager']), '/expenses' -> Expenses (allowedRoles=['admin','manager']), '/reports' -> Reports (allowedRoles=['admin','manager']), '/settings' -> Settings (allowedRoles=['admin']). path='*' -> Navigate to='/dashboard'.

Write src/components/pos/ProductSearch.jsx. Props: products array, onAddToCart function. State: searchQuery, activeCategory ('All'). Category tabs: All, Vet Drug, Agro Chemical, Equipment, Consumable using .tab-bar/.tab-btn classes. Search input using .search-input class with placeholder 'Search by name or SKU...'. Filtered products: filter by activeCategory (if not All) AND searchQuery (matches name or sku case-insensitive). Render product grid div.product-grid. Each product: div.product-card (key=product.id). Inside: div.product-card-name, div.product-card-sku (sku), div.product-card-price ('N' + selling_price.toLocaleString()). Stock badge in top-right: if quantity===0 show Badge variant='danger' text='OUT'; elif quantity<=reorder_level show Badge variant='warn' text='LOW'; else nothing. onClick card calls onAddToCart(product) if quantity>0. If quantity===0 apply opacity:0.5 cursor:not-allowed to card.

Write src/components/pos/Cart.jsx. Props: onSaleComplete function. Reads posStore for items, customer, paymentMethod, discount, discountType. Reads authStore for role. Cart header: div.pos-cart-header 'CART ({items.length} items)'. Cart body div.pos-cart-body: if empty show EmptyState with cart icon. Each item: div.cart-item -- name+sku left, qty controls center (minus btn, qty number, plus btn using .cart-qty-btn), price right, remove X button. Below item: if role is admin or manager show override price input (small, inline, 'Override price' placeholder) that calls posStore.setOverridePrice. Cart footer div.pos-cart-footer: Customer name input (labeled 'Customer (optional)'). Payment method: three buttons Cash/Transfer/Credit, selected one gets brand background. Discount row: toggle between % and flat-N, number input. Totals section: Subtotal row, Discount row (only if discount>0), bold Total row. If paymentMethod=Cash and amountTendered input shown: 'Amount Tendered' input, 'Change' display row. Disabled 'Complete Sale' button if cart empty. Active 'Complete Sale' .btn-accent button that calls onSaleComplete with sale data.

Write src/components/pos/Receipt.jsx. Props: sale object {receiptId, items, subtotal, discount, total, paymentMethod, amountTendered, change, customerName, cashierName, createdAt}, onClose function, open boolean. Renders as Modal size='sm'. Receipt content: header with shop name 'AgroVet POS', receipt ID in monospace, date+time formatted. Divider line. Items table: product name, qty, unit price, line total -- no thead styling (plain lines). Totals section. Payment info. Footer text from mockSettings. Print button (.btn-ghost) calls window.print(). Close button. The receipt-modal content has a print CSS class that only shows the receipt when printing (via @media print in pos.css hiding everything but .receipt-print-content).

Write src/pages/POS.jsx. State: products (load from mock or Supabase on mount), showReceipt (false), lastReceipt (null). Load products: if useMock use mockProducts; else supabase.from('products').select('*').order('name'). Render div.pos-layout containing ProductSearch (left 60%) and Cart (right 40%). Handle onAddToCart: calls posStore.addItem(product). Handle onSaleComplete: 1) build sale object with receiptId = 'RCPT-' + today YYYYMMDD + '-' + padded counter; 2) if not mock: insert into sales table, insert sale_items, decrement product quantities, insert stock_movements; 3) if mock: update mockProducts quantities in place, increment mockSettings.receipt_counter; 4) set lastReceipt and showReceipt=true; 5) call posStore.clearCart(). Show Receipt modal when showReceipt=true.

Write src/pages/Dashboard.jsx. On mount load data (mock or Supabase). Compute: todaySales = sum of sales where date = today from mockSales; totalProducts = mockProducts.length; lowStockCount = mockProducts.filter(p=>p.quantity<=p.reorder_level).length; pendingPurchases = mockPurchases.filter(p=>p.status==='Ordered').length. Stat grid (4 cards) using StatCard component: Today's Sales (variant based on value), Total Products, Low Stock (variant='warn' if >0), Pending Purchases. Charts row: BarChart (Recharts, 60% width) of sales by day for last 7 days -- use mockSales grouped by date; PieChart (Recharts, 40% width) of sales grouped by payment method. Recent Sales section: .section-title 'RECENT SALES', .results-table with columns Receipt ID, Customer, Total, Payment, Cashier, Time -- last 10 sales from mockSales. Low Stock section: .section-title 'LOW STOCK ALERT', .results-table with columns SKU, Product, Category, Qty, Reorder Level, Supplier -- only products where quantity<=reorder_level.

Run npm run build from /Users/macbookpro/Desktop/ProgrammoCeuticals/agro_shop/ to verify zero errors. Then run npm run dev briefly and verify in browser that login redirects to dashboard, dashboard shows stat cards and charts with mock data, and POS page shows split layout.
Set FEAT-002 status to 'completed'. Record findings about any patterns used in Login/Dashboard/POS that FEAT-003/004 should replicate.
acceptance_criteria: Login page renders correctly, accepts any credentials in mock mode, redirects to /dashboard
Dashboard renders 4 stat cards with non-zero values from mock data
Dashboard renders BarChart and PieChart without console errors
POS page shows 60/40 split layout with product grid on left and cart on right
Adding a product to cart appears in cart panel
Completing a sale shows the Receipt modal with a RCPT-YYYYMMDD-XXXX receipt ID
